learning_outcomes.text: The student will know and apply the concepts of integrated production.

syllabus_topics: PROCESS ENGINEERING - Introduction to Lean Manufacturing philosophy.
STORAGE - Warehouse design with LEAN principles.
ENVIRONMENTAL ASSESSMENT AND OPTIMIZATION OF PRODUCTION PROCESSES THROUGH LIFE CYCLE ASSESSMENT (LCA).
General aspects of Life Cycle Analysis.
Environmental assessment and optimization of production processes through Life Cycle Assessment (LCA).
Applications of the LCA methodology in the design of productive processes.
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 35% must be obtained in the written test. If this minimum is not met, the total grade will be the sum of scores from all evaluation criteria, capped at 4.5 points. For part-time students, non-recoverable activities may be replaced by similar or equivalent tests under specific conditions.
